questions.question_text:
The underlined statement has four reasons for its justification. Write the serial number of the reason you think correct:
People wear sunglasses on bright days because:-
options: (1) It improves their ability to see perfectly in the dark.
(2) They protect the eyes from harmful UV rays and reduce intense glare.
(3) The dark lenses make the surrounding air physically cooler.
(4) It is a legal requirement for walking outdoors in the summer.
questions.explanation: They protect the eyes from harmful UV rays and glare.

questions.question_text:
The underlined statement has four reasons for its justification. Write the serial number of the reason you think correct:
Large ships drop heavy metal anchors into the water because:-
options: (1) The anchor pulls the ship forward at high speeds.
(2) It grips the sea floor to prevent the ship from drifting with wind and currents.
(3) It acts as a lightning rod to absorb storms.
(4) Dropping the anchor instantly purifies the surrounding saltwater.
questions.explanation: It grips the sea floor to prevent drifting.

questions.question_text: If 5 books cost 250 rupees, what is the cost of 8 books?

questions.question_text: A man walks 10 meters South, turns left and walks 10 meters, then turns left again and walks 10 meters. In which direction is he now from his starting point?
questions.explanation: He faces South, turns left to East, turns left to North. He ends up 10 meters East of his start.

questions.question_text: Pointing to a girl, a boy says, 'She is the daughter of my father's only brother.' How is the girl related to the boy?
questions.explanation: 'My father's only brother' is his uncle. His uncle's daughter is his cousin.

questions.question_text: If the word 'SUN' is coded as 54, and 'MOON' is coded as 57, how is the word 'STAR' coded?
questions.explanation: Sum of alphabetical positions: S=19, T=20, A=1, R=18. 19+20+1+18 = 58.

questions.question_text: If the 2nd of a month falls on a Tuesday, what day of the week will the 23rd of the same month be?
questions.explanation: The difference is 21 days, exactly 3 weeks. The day remains the same: Tuesday.
